statement: For every prescribed seed and branch in the theorem, set p = 2 and take uj, Fj, Bj from Lemma 3.4. If the seed has the form (3.9), we may instead take p = 4 with the finite coefficient construction. In both cases, ψ − p X j=1 ϵj uj β = O(ϵp+1 ), Lψ − p X j=1 ϵj Fj 2β = O(ϵp+1 ), ∂sψ|S − p X j=1 ϵj Bj C0(S) = O(ϵp+1 ). (3.16) 12 The area and all four mass components have actual expansions to the same order. Their mass coefficients are aµj[q] = Gµ(uj, Fj, Bj), pµ(ϵ) = pµ(0) + p X j=1 ϵj aµj[q] + O(ϵp+1 ). (3.17) In particular, the actual deficit satisfies Dq(ϵ) = c2[q]ϵ2 + O(ϵ3 ) (3.18) for every seed under consideration. The coefficient c2 is a continuous quadratic form on Tτ,α in the ∥ · ∥β topology, invariant under rotations. For seeds of the form (3.9) there is additionally the actual expansion Dq(ϵ) = c2[q]ϵ2 + c3[q]ϵ3 + c4[q]ϵ4 + O(ϵ5 ). (3.19) The subsequent geometric arguments determine the signs and the vanishing of these coeffi- cients.
